articles.title: Harry and Meghan's media treatment echoes what happened to Diana, Earl Spencer tells BBC
articles.description: Princess Diana's brother says she was "really brought low by all that criticism" and he saw her in "tears of despair".

articles.title: Watch: Diana's brother says press has 'cancerous influence' on Harry and Meghan's lives
articles.description: Earl Spencer says that he can see echoes of Princess Diana's treatment from the press in the way Harry and Meghan are scrutinised.

articles.title: Ed Sheeran admits 'mistakes' as he addresses Macklemore controversy at Philadelphia show
articles.description: The mega-star spoke about Israel and Gaza at his first concert since rapper Macklemore was removed from his tour.

articles.title: Two killed in 'massive' Ukrainian drone attack on Moscow region, says Russia
articles.description: An oil refinery was also reportedly hit in Moscow, and flights were suspended at two capital airports.
